# Cinematic title

The cinematic-title recipe: a letterboxed, glowing title card with a lens-flare streak and wide uppercase tracking, for openers and film-style title moments.

- Type: Cinematic title
- Skill: `magnifito-promo`
- Engine: `hyperframes`
- Output: 1920x1080, 6 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/s01-cinematic-title.mp4`](../videos/s01-cinematic-title.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 6-second 16:9 title card for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, in the cinematic-title style. The title is "Magnifito" with the approved service line "Websites, social media, email, ads and automation" under it (claim-services in claims.json). Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, the logo green #8acf31 used sparingly, Geist from fonts/, and the logo in assets/magnifito-logo.svg. Render it with HyperFrames.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s01-cinematic-title
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s01-cinematic-title/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render . --force
```

The finished file is `runs/*/final_output_*.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
